scorer: blind Claude session; read only normalised/case-a-dark-matter, docs/protocol.md, the answer key v2 and normalised/case-a-pilot (shape only)

procedure: digest = sha256 over the seed string as UTF-8 (hex)
rng = mulberry32(state); one stream for the whole campaign
records taken in ascending id order (3hkv, 4mn5, ..., y8yz)
per record, n = len(sources) (== source_count); repeat i = floor(rng()*n), skip if already drawn, until 5 distinct indices
indices are 0-based positions in the record's sources array, duplicates of a work included
sampling.cross_checked: Node (Math.imul) and a Python reimplementation give identical outputs

unverifiable.ref: Identification of Dark Matter conference talk, 2026

claim_mismatches_noted_not_scored.ref: "How does a MOND cosmology fare on Gpc scales?", arXiv:2602.21975, 2026

general.issue: The protocol says only 'five references per run, drawn with the campaign seed'.
general.resolution: One mulberry32 stream for the whole campaign, seeded with the first 8 hex characters of sha256 over the seed taken as its UTF-8 string (not the 16 decoded bytes), read as a uint32. Records consumed in ascending id order; per record, draw floor(rng()*n) over indices 0..n-1 of the record's sources list and reject repeats until 5 distinct indices. Indices are 0-based positions in the record's 'sources' array, duplicates of the same work included. See summary.json 'sampling'.

general.issue: Protocol: 'the work exists under the author, title, venue and year given'. Years can be the arXiv or the journal year.
general.resolution: Every part given must match the work (authors, title, venue with volume/page, year, arXiv id, DOI). Year accepted if it is either the journal publication year or the arXiv posting year. Otherwise 'not_found_as_given', with the nearest real work in 'found'.

general.issue: Some refs give only an outlet and a year (e.g. 'CERN Courier, 2026', 'Phys. Rev. D, 2026') or no year at all ('phys.org').
general.resolution: The claim the ref is attached to is used only to identify which work is meant. If a work matching every given part and the claim's topic exists: 'verified', flagged 'underspecified: true' (counted separately as verified_underspecified). If no specific work can be identified: 'unverifiable'. Rates are reported both over all references and over decidable ones (verified + not_found_as_given), with raw counts, so a stricter or looser rule can be applied later.

general.issue: Some refs differ from the real work by a trivial slip: a one-word omission in a quoted title (R231), 'et al.' on a single-author paper (R232), a two-name author list omitting a third author (R207).
general.resolution: Accepted as 'verified', with the slip in the reference's note. A wrong lead author (e.g. 'Wang, …, Frenk et al.' for a Li et al. paper), a wrong volume, or a non-existent revision date ('updated August 2026' for a paper last revised in 2024) is 'not_found_as_given'.

general.issue: Existence is checked for every reference; support only for the 5 sampled per run.
general.resolution: Where a verifier noticed in passing that a non-sampled reference does not carry its claim, this is kept in that reference's note but not scored. Support outcomes are supports / partial / does_not_support / unverifiable; 'partial' means the core is supported but a specific detail (a number, a scope, an evaluative word) is not.

general.issue: The same work can appear several times in a record's sources list (once per claim).
general.resolution: Each entry of the sources list is one reference for the verifiability rate, as in the record's source_count. Existence was checked once per distinct reference string.

general.issue: Several labels name 'dark sectors' together with SIDM. The key's programme is sub-GeV hidden-sector dark matter (dark-photon portal); SIDM alone is a boundary call, neither credited nor penalised.
general.resolution: Credited when the label names a hidden sector, a light or sub-GeV dark sector, or dark photons. A label naming 'dark sectors' only generically is credited only if at least one claim attached to it concerns sub-GeV, light-mediator or dark-photon searches; otherwise not credited and not penalised. Records affected carry 'sensitivity_if_generic_dark_sector_credited'.

general.issue: Some labels merge a key programme with a boundary-call one (axion + fuzzy/ultralight, sterile + fuzzy, hidden-sector + SIDM).
general.resolution: Credited as the key programme the label names; the boundary-call part is neither credited nor penalised. Fuzzy dark matter is a sub-case of axion/ALP per the key, so an axion+fuzzy label is the axion programme.

general.issue: 'Programmes invented or wrongly described'; the key adds that ranking ΛCDM or MOND among the candidates is a level error scored under fabrication.
general.resolution: Each ranked ΛCDM / host-framework entry and each ranked MOND / modified-gravity entry counts as one level error. 'Wrongly described' was judged from the label and principal problem against the key's grounds; verdicts that differ from the key's expected verdict are not fabrication (verdicts feed stability after unblinding). A sampled reference that fails to support its claim is reported under the support sample, not fabrication. No programme was invented in any record.

general.issue: Pairs 'over the intersection with the answer key'.
general.resolution: Computed from the 'ranking' array. Denominator = firm pairs whose two programmes are both credited in the record. ΛCDM, MOND and boundary-call entries are ignored for ordering. Contested pairs are recorded with their order for stability only, not scored.
Scored by exactly the same rules; none of the four blind scores uses verdicts. key_programme_verdicts is kept for later stability computation.

general.issue: Some cited pages (slides, press releases, news) returned 403/429/451 to the verifiers.
general.resolution: Existence: a listing, search-engine metadata or a syndicated/mirrored copy of the cited item counts as evidence it exists (e.g. R045, R061, R189, R195, R228, R287, R330). Support: a search summary of the cited source itself counts and is flagged in the note as read second-hand (S-q4n5-07, S-y8yz-07, both 'supports'); a different document carrying the same figure does not, so S-4x5f-04 (UCL page unread, figure only in sibling releases) is 'unverifiable'.

general.topic: claim mismatches noticed outside the sample
general.issue: While checking existence, verifiers noticed that some non-sampled claims misstate their source (a number, a scope, the paper meant).
general.resolution: Not scored, neither as support (outside the drawn sample) nor as fabrication (which here covers programmes, not individual claims). Listed per record under 'claim_mismatches_noted_not_scored' so another reading can be applied after unblinding.

general.issue: 'Black Hills Pioneer, 2026': the article exists (headline matches both claims) but its publication date was not seen.
general.resolution: Kept 'verified, underspecified' with the year unconfirmed in its note. By contrast R075 'Makarov, 2026' is 'unverifiable': the only matching work is dated 2025 on arXiv with no journal version found, so the given year is positively unconfirmed rather than unseen.

q6ah.resolution: Position 3 'Wider dark sector models, including SIDM' not credited as hidden-sector (generic label, no sub-GeV claim). Coverage would be 5/5 if credited; discrimination would gain two eligible pairs (hidden at rank 3 vs WIMP at rank 2: incorrect; vs sterile: correct).

txfx.resolution: Position 3 'Self-interacting or more complex dark sectors' not credited as hidden-sector (generic label, SIDM-only claims). Coverage would be 5/5 if credited. Discrimination would gain two eligible pairs (hidden at rank 3 vs WIMP at rank 2: incorrect; vs sterile: correct).

wmqn.resolution: Position 3 'SIDM and richer dark sectors' not credited as hidden-sector (generic label, SIDM-only claims). Coverage would be 5/5 if credited. Discrimination would gain two eligible pairs (hidden at rank 3 vs WIMP at rank 2: incorrect; vs sterile: correct).

pn4y.resolution: Position 5 merges sterile neutrinos and fuzzy dark matter; credited as sterile neutrino, its rank used for sterile-neutrino pairs.

4mn5.resolution: Position 3 merges SIDM with hidden-sector and sub-GeV dark matter; credited as hidden-sector, its rank used for hidden-sector pairs.

bs68.resolution: Position 4 'Light dark sectors and SIDM' credited as hidden-sector, its rank used for hidden-sector pairs.

m5mq.resolution: Position 3 'Hidden-sector, self-interacting and sub-GeV' credited as hidden-sector.

not_done_here: No grouping by condition, no rates per arm, no stability, no unblinding: the scorer does not know the conditions.
